name: DCWP Language Line Interpretation Services
description:
This dataset records individual calls handled through the DCWP Language Line interpretation service, with 5,000 sampled rows and four columns. Each row captures a single interpreted call: a timestamp (date), the language interpreted (36 distinct languages, including Spanish, Mandarin, and Cantonese), the department or program area that requested interpretation (access_code, with 13 categories such as Intake, Licensing, Collections, Paid Sick Leave, and Adjudication), and the call length in seconds (duration_seconds, ranging from 7 to 6,703 seconds, averaging about 588 seconds).

The data can be used to analyze demand for language services over time, compare call volumes and durations across languages and program areas, identify which departments rely most on interpretation, and spot peak periods or unusually long calls. It supports operational planning such as staffing interpreter capacity, budgeting for interpretation services, and assessing language access across agency functions. Because the sample covers only 5,000 rows, it is best suited to exploratory
